## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Es liegt mir am Herzen** — [ess leekt meer am HAIR-tsen] — *It matters deeply to me*
2. **Ich bin ganz bei dir** — [ish bin gahnts bye deer] — *I'm fully with you / I completely agree*
3. **Das ergibt Sinn** — [dahs air-GEEPT zinn] — *That makes sense*
